title: Elina Pilates Wooden Cadillac
overviewParagraph: The Wooden Cadillac is a premium Pilates apparatus built from American rock maple for exceptional stability and long-term durability. Stainless steel and anodized aluminum components deliver smooth, reliable performance through repeated sessions, while a leather-upholstered bed is engineered to hold up to heavy use. High-density EVA foam cushioning provides comfortable, supportive contact so you can focus on controlled movement and alignment. Designed to comply with environmental regulations, it’s a dependable choice for consistent Pilates training.
features: 6 short, 4 long color-coded springs with handles
10-year warranty on structure, 2 years on parts
inclusions: Continuous mat to fully cover the surface. Very light
Horizontal and vertical movement bars with quick adjustment system
Anodized aluminum stretching bar with rubber grip and padded protection. With safety strap. For upper and lower springs. Adjustable in 3 positions
Wooden trapeze bar with padded protection; covered springs for added safety; hanging strap
Short Cadillac springs with handles: 2 yellow (light), 2 green (medium), and 2 red (strong)
Long Cadillac springs with handles: 2 yellow (light), 2 green (medium)
1 pair of simple padded cotton handles
1 pair of very soft Fuzzies handles
